footnotes: Note: a. For the purpose of rationing, it is assumed that polished barley and polished wheat are the equivalent of polished rice.

tables.title: Projection of Korean Food Stock Position, 1 July 1948 - 30 June 1949

footnotes: Note: a. For the purposes of rationing, it is assumed that polished barley and polished wheat are the equivalents of polished rice.
